_description: ISCA'27 mesh9 scaled v4 Complete: v4_complete.json on the scaled 9x9 wafer (mi200_9x9s.json values) with the requester window and composed table scaled with the RDMA window: t18-window 154 (256 x 0.6), t18-compose-table-entries 308 (2W).
_scaling: mesh9 scaled config (user 10-22): 9x9 mesh, 80 GPMs, each GPM about 0.6 = 48/80 of an mi200 GPM so that the wafer has about the resources of the 7x7 mi200 wafer; problem sizes stay the 7x7 ones (-problem-gpms 48, -problem-cus-per-gpm 28). Hop latency 32 cycles as before.
_deviation-scaling: Rounding: CUs 28 -> 16 (8 SA x 2; x0.571, wafer 1280 CUs = 95% of 1344); L2 8 x 256 KiB -> 5 x 256 KiB = 1.25 MiB (x0.625; slices must equal memory controllers); HBM2e 8 -> 5 channels (x0.625; wafer HBM bandwidth 104% of 7x7); link -bandwidth 24 -> 14 flits/cycle (224 GB/s, x0.583, 14.4 not representable; 14 is -2.8% from 0.6, 15 would be +4.2%); RDMA window 256 -> 154 (x0.602). -switch-buffer-flits stays 16. Interleaving over 5 slices/controllers is modulo 5.
_wg-distribution: 1344-WG kernels (one per CU of 7x7) would fill only 42 of 80 GPMs with the ceil split (1280 CUs); balanced spreads every kernel over all GPMs.
